scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,worker -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C web dev" "wrangler dev --var ACCESS_DEV_BYPASS:true"
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && node scripts/deploy-config.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.deploy.json --secrets-file .wrangler/deploy-secrets.env
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/deploy-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply ratatoskr --remote -c wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit && pnpm -C web typecheck
